+    }

## How "Execute Tag Run Group" works

### Call chain

1. **Activation** → `activateNotebookRunGroups` → `registerCommands`
2. **Command** `jupyter-cell-tags.executeRunGroup` → QuickPick → `executeGroup`
3. **Filter** all notebook cells by tag → pass `{ ranges: targetCells }` to `notebook.cell.execute`

---

### 1. Exact paths and function names

| Role | Path | Function / symbol |
|------|------|-------------------|
| Activation | `C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\notebookRunGroups\startup.ts` | `activateNotebookRunGroups` |
| Command registration | `...\src\notebookRunGroups\commands.ts` | `registerCommands` → registers `jupyter-cell-tags.executeRunGroup` |
| Command contribution / title | `...\package.json` | `"jupyter-cell-tags.executeRunGroup"` / `"🏷️▶️ Execute Tag Run Group"` |
| Tag selection UI | `...\src\notebookRunGroups\commands.ts` | `quickPickAllRunGroupTags` |
| Tag list source | `...\src\util\notebookSelection.ts` | `getAllTagsFromActiveNotebook` |
| Optional cell context | `...\src\util\notebookSelection.ts` | `argNotebookCell` |
| Find cells by tag | `...\src\notebookRunGroups\util\cellActionHelpers.ts` | `executeGroup` + `cellInGroup` |
| Tag read | `...\src\helper.ts` | `getCellTags` |
| Execute | `...\src\notebookRunGroups\util\cellActionHelpers.ts` | `executeGroup` → `notebook.cell.execute` |
| Related tree "Run Tag" | `...\src\noteAllTags\allNotebookTagsTreeDataProvider.ts` | `jupyter-cell-tags.runTag` → loops + calls `executeGroup` |

---

### 2. Key snippets

**Command + QuickPick** (`commands.ts`):

```63:74:src/notebookRunGroups/commands.ts
        vscode.commands.registerCommand('jupyter-cell-tags.executeRunGroup', async (args) => {
            // const tag = await quickPickAllTags();
            const tag = await quickPickAllRunGroupTags();
            if (tag) {
                executeGroup(tag, argNotebookCell(args));
            }
            else {
                log('no tag');
            }
        })
```

`quickPickAllRunGroupTags` loads all tags, puts tags containing `"run"` first, then shows a QuickPick (`placeholder: 'Type to select a cell run tag'`).

**Filter + execute — intended to run ALL matching cells** (`cellActionHelpers.ts`):

```122:156:src/notebookRunGroups/util/cellActionHelpers.ts
export function executeGroup(targetRunTag: string, notebookCell?: vscode.NotebookCell) {
    let doc = notebookCell?.notebook;
    if (!doc) {
        doc = vscode.window.activeNotebookEditor?.notebook;
        doc || log('Execute group called without a valid document to execute');
    }

    const targetCells = doc
        ?.getCells()
        .filter((notebookCell) => cellInGroup(notebookCell, targetRunTag))
        .map((cell) => {
            // ... logging ...
            return { start: cell.index, end: cell.index + 1 };
        });

    vscode.commands.executeCommand('notebook.cell.execute', { ranges: targetCells });
    log('done executing');
}

function cellInGroup(cell: vscode.NotebookCell, targetCellTag: string) {
    const tags = getCellTags(cell);
    if (tags.includes(targetCellTag)) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

There is **no early-exit loop inside `executeGroup`**. It builds one `ranges` array for every tagged cell and fires a single `notebook.cell.execute`.

**Likely reason only the first cell runs:** Jupyter Enhancements hijacks `notebook.cell.execute` and only uses `ranges[0]`:

```198:201:src/jupyterEnhancements/extension.ts
		singleHijack = vscode.commands.registerCommand('notebook.cell.execute', async (args) => {
			output.appendLine("[DEBUG] >> Hijack: Run Single");
			await runSingleHandler(args);
		});
```

```297:300:src/jupyterEnhancements/extension.ts
	else if (args && args.ranges && args.ranges.length > 0) {
		cell = editor.notebook.cellAt(args.ranges[0].start);
	}
```

That feature is **on by default** (`featureFlags.ts`: `jupyterEnhancements: true`), activated from `extension.ts`.

**Tree-view `runTag` oddity:** it loops cell refs but calls `executeGroup(tag, cell)` each time — so it re-filters the whole notebook per iteration (redundant, not a “stop after first” filter bug):

```572:579:src/noteAllTags/allNotebookTagsTreeDataProvider.ts
        for (const cellRef of cellRefs) {
            const cell = editor.notebook.cellAt(cellRef.index);
            if (cell) {
                executeGroup(tag, cell);    // Execute the group of cells
            }
        }
```

---

### 3. History / comments — always meant to run all tagged cells

- Docs: README / `.kiro/steering/product.md` — “Execute all cells with a specific tag”
- `426432b` (2024-09-26) — added `jupyter-cell-tags.executeRunGroup` with `executeGroup` filtering all cells
- `3a765b6` (2024-09-30) — moved `executeGroup` to `cellActionHelpers.ts`; same multi-range `notebook.cell.execute` behavior (unchanged since)
- `b2afe29` — filtering for run-group tag QuickPick (“run” tags first)
- `f73a6f8` — include all tags in run-tag options, not only “good” ones
- Hijack that truncates to first range: `43fd3fa8` (2026-02-11) in `jupyterEnhancements/extension.ts` — **after** run-group execution was written

So run-group code still *collects* all tagged cells; multi-cell execution likely broke when the `notebook.cell.execute` hijack was added.

---
